subtitle.en: Official docs + the 161-entry audit index: claims, gaps, and where the documents contradict each other.
subtitle.zh: 官方文档 + 161 条审计索引：结论、缺口，以及文档互相矛盾的地方。

claims.claim: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens

ev.text: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens — a minimum threshold that deters spam proposals. To pass, a proposal requires the winning option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.
ev.hl: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens

claims.verify: open lido.fi/governance → "Regular process" → "Off-chain voting", first paragraph
claims.after: ### On-chain voting — To pass, a proposal requires the "yes" option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.

title.en: Passing bar: 5% of supply plus a simple majority
title.zh: 通过条件：5% 总供应 + 简单多数

title.en: Veto signalling: >1% stETH blocks motions 5–45 days

claims.claim: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply
claims.section: Dual Governance: Veto Signaling and Rage Quit

ev.text: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply in the signaling escrow. This blocks governance motions for 5 to 45 days, depending on the amount of opposing tokens. This provides time for negotiation between LDO and stETH holders.
ev.hl: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply

claims.verify: open lido.fi/governance → expand "Dual Governance: Veto Signaling and Rage Quit", first paragraph
claims.before: ### Dual Governance: stETH holders challenge window — After passing the vote, on-chain actions targeting Lido on Ethereum protocol enter Dual Governance — a dynamic timelock that allows stETH holders to extend execution delay based on the level of opposition.
claims.after: Rage Quit is triggered when >10% of the total stETH supply is locked in the signaling escrow. Governance stays paused until opposing stakers exit the protocol.

title.zh: Rage Quit：>10% stETH 暂停治理

ev.text: With over 55,000 unique LDO token holders, the Lido DAO stewards the protocol towards community and decentralization alignment. Additional safeguard for the protocol is provided by stETH holders via the Dual Governance system that allows them to delay contentious proposals before execution.

title.en: 31 of 161 entries carry no issue count
title.zh: 其中 31 条没有 issue 数字

q.en: Is there a token unlock or vesting schedule?
q.zh: LDO 的代币解锁 / 归属时间表？

gaps.a: The provided evidence does not include the LDO token unlock schedule or vesting terms.

why.en: The official docs contain no such schedule.
why.zh: 官方文档里根本没有这份时间表

q.en: What is the total LDO supply?
q.zh: LDO 的总供应量是多少？

gaps.a: The provided evidence does not specify a numeric total supply for LDO tokens.

why.en: The 5% quorum cites a number the documents never state.
why.zh: 5% 的法定人数引用了一个文档从不给出的数字

q.en: What do the 31 entries without counts contain?
q.zh: 31 条没有 issue 数字的条目里写了什么？

gaps.a: 31 / 161 entries carry no Total Issues line.

why.en: Issue totals are comparable for 130 entries only.
why.zh: 总量只能对 130 条比较

q.zh: 标为 Acknowledged 的问题后来修了吗？

gaps.a: The index has no field for whether a later audit resolved an earlier finding.

why.en: 98 entries carry acknowledged findings; the index has no follow-up field.
why.zh: 98 条含 Acknowledged，但没有跟进字段
